title: The Baby Monitor Picked Up a Second Voice #shorts #horror
description: I was babysitting. The monitor was supposed to be silent. Then someone started singing to the baby. #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

hook.text: Never trust a quiet baby monitor.

lines.text: I was babysitting for the new family next door.
The baby fell asleep early. The house went silent.
Around midnight, the baby monitor crackled.
Someone was humming a lullaby. Softly.
I called the parents. They were still at dinner.
The mother went quiet. Then she said, we don't have a monitor.
I looked down at the little speaker in my hand.
The humming stopped. A voice whispered, she's sleeping now.
I ran upstairs. The nursery door was locked.
From inside, something knocked back. Three slow times.
